title: Verify European Freezeblink compact bank
changes: Document an ordinary Freezeblink route to the represented 6babc4 compact bank.
validation: Wine source and six existing EUR roster prefixes identify action45/task45, its 6babc4 child and an eligible IN08 unit; normal menu screenshots confirm Freezeblink and its confirmation.
A 600-frame native raw/managed full-state/clock/render/OAM/dispatch/five-audio pair passed in Wine; the feature-gated watch observed represented address 0x086babc6 at frame 8361.
The test artifact was emitted before the audit Cargo build failed on the CLI with ENOSPC; its 845-file source snapshot and artifact hash were verified and the previous CLI remained unchanged.
limitations: One invocation only; complete animation, other selectors and consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
